user.title: OpenWeatherMap (Startup plan)
user.description:
Requires an API key on a plan that includes the 16-day daily forecast endpoint. The free tier does not.

init.title: Options
init.description:
Weather data © OpenWeather, licensed under ODbL.

Forecast length, air quality windows and the update interval are fixed at the values the Startup plan supports: 16-day daily forecast, 120-hour 3-hourly forecast, air quality peaks for today and tomorrow, and hourly updates.

data_description.basemap_url: Tile template with {z}, {x} and {y} placeholders, drawn behind the weather maps. Defaults to the CARTO style Home Assistant itself uses. Leave empty for no basemap. Do not point this at tile.openstreetmap.org: their usage policy forbids it.
data_description.basemap_attribution: Burned into the corner of every map image. Update this if you change the basemap URL.
data_description.contrast_stretch: OpenWeather's palettes cover the whole globe, so across a 200 km view the colours barely change. With this on, the values present in the view are re-mapped across a full colour ramp and the legend follows. Turn it off for OpenWeather's own colours.
